notes.title: Top Sellers is now BIZTOPIA – Official Trailer & Big Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Top Sellers Ecommerce Simulator is continuing its journey with a brand-new name: BIZTOPIA![/b] [/p][p]Formerly known as [i]Top Sellers[/i], our game is now here with a fresh name and vision: [b]BIZTOPIA[/b], inspired by trade and entrepreneurship simulation. 🌍💼[/p][p]Imagine this: you start your e-commerce journey in a small town. Your first sales are exciting, and over time, bigger opportunities begin to open up. You discover new investment areas, launch different ventures, and every decision you make shapes your business journey. With the big update coming on [b]September 29th[/b], you’ll be able to step into the world of BIZTOPIA, beginning with e-commerce and expanding into so much more.[/p][p]Watch the trailer and share your thoughts; your business journey starts now! [/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your feedback, because you’ve been with us since the very beginning of this journey. ❤️[/p]

notes.title: 📢 The Long-Awaited News Has Arrived! – Big Update on September 29!
notes.notes: [p]Beyond e-commerce, a never-before-seen world awaits you.[/p][p]Now you can play co-op, build strategies with your friends, and grow your business.[/p][p]With new gameplay mechanics, an open-world map, and surprises, the update takes the trading experience to a whole new level.[/p][p]What starts with e-commerce evolves into a trading game full of unexpected business opportunities.[/p][p]And until September 29, surprise changes also await you on our page.[/p][p]Are you ready? The big update arrives on September 29![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 The Huge Update is Live! 🚀
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to bring you the long-awaited news! With this massive update, we’ve taken our game to the next level. Exciting new features, improvements, and surprises await you. Let’s dive into the details:

[b]🆕 Brand New Features[/b]

[b]🌍 A Bigger Map[/b]
Expand your e-commerce empire on a larger map! Explore new areas and grow your business like never before.

[b]🚁 Drone Deliveries[/b]
You can now send express delivery orders via drones! The future of e-commerce is here.

[b]🔧 New Equipment System[/b]
• Take control of your warehouse—shelves, pallets, workbenches, and even lighting can now be managed from the equipment screen.
• Sell unnecessary equipment, buy new ones, and optimize your workflow!

[b]📱 Tablet[/b]
Say goodbye to running back and forth to your warehouse! Manage orders and stock directly from your tablet.

[b]⭐ New Level System[/b]
• Introducing a brand-new level system with 100 levels!
• Earn XP from completing orders, making purchases, and deliveries.
• Unlock new equipment and take your business to the next level.

[b]📦 Stock System for Wholesalers[/b]
No more unlimited supplies! Stock quantities at wholesalers are now limited, making supply planning a vital part of your strategy.

[b]🚚 Automated Deliveries[/b]
Let your trade manager handle deliveries—products purchased from wholesalers can now be sent directly to your warehouse. Focus on your strategies while we handle the logistics!

[b]🎁 New Store: Gift Shop[/b]
• Discover 45 brand-new gift items! Add a splash of color to your business with this exciting new category.

[b]💡 Game Balance Updates[/b]
• Market items are now only available for in-city deliveries.
• Cleaners can be delivered both in-city and locally.
• Tipping System: Customers are extra generous with in-city deliveries! Plus, these orders grant higher XP rewards.

[b]🏆 Leaderboard System[/b]
Check out the rankings from the main menu and see who’s generating the most revenue. The competition is on!

[b]📦 Order Fulfillment Enhancements[/b]
• Tape Machine: After placing products in boxes, you’ll now need to tape them for a more realistic packing experience.
• RFID Reader: Instead of automatically showing product locations in your warehouse, you’ll scan boxes to find where they’re stored.
• Enjoy enhanced packing animations with foam and other materials for a more immersive experience.

[b]🏷️ Labeling Systems[/b]
• Pallet Labeling: Easily decide which products go on which pallets.
• Vehicle Labeling: Specify which products your delivery driver needs to load onto the vehicle.

[b]⚙️ Settings Updates[/b]
• Added FPS limiting and reverse mouse axis (X-Y) options.
• New control screen for easier customization of gameplay settings.

[b]🕹️ Steam Deck Support[/b]
That’s right! You can now enjoy Top Sellers on Steam Deck!

[b]🔧 Improvements[/b]

[b]🚗 Improved Vehicle Handling[/b]
Driving is now smoother than ever! Experience easier turns and better vehicle physics for a more enjoyable driving experience.

[b]🔔 Notification Sounds[/b]
In-game notification sounds have been made softer and more pleasant.

[b]🌆 Visual Upgrades[/b]
City lighting and traffic signals have been revamped to make the environment more realistic and visually stunning.

[b]🔜 Coming Soon[/b]

[b]🚉 Trains and Airports[/b]
Have you noticed the train station and airport on the map? Stay tuned—these areas will soon become active, bringing exciting new gameplay elements!

[b]🚶‍♂️ NPCs and Traffic[/b]
We’re working on increasing the number of NPCs and enabling city traffic. Get ready for a livelier, more dynamic city!

[b]🔌 Electric Vehicles[/b]
Make your deliveries eco-friendly by switching to an electric vehicle! Manage charging and maintenance as part of your sustainable e-commerce strategy.

[b]💬 We Value Your Time[/b]
We know how much time and effort you’ve invested in the game, and we deeply respect that. That’s why we’ve introduced a migration system to ensure you don’t lose your progress!

When you log in and select "Continue Game," your previous progress will automatically migrate to the new system, allowing you to pick up right where you left off.

If you’d prefer, you can also start fresh to fully experience the new features and improvements. Whether you continue or start anew, the choice is yours! 😊

[b]💬 Your Feedback Matters![/b]
This update was shaped by your valuable feedback. Don’t forget to try out the new features and share your thoughts with us. Stay tuned for even more exciting content in the future!

Happy selling,
The Lymo Games Team

notes.title: Top Sellers: Big Update is Here + Exciting Features on the Way!
notes.notes:
First of all, a big thank you for your interest in our game, Top Sellers, and for all your valuable feedback! 💛 After seeing streamers experience and share our game, we carefully listened to both them and you, our beloved players. Based on your comments, we prioritized the most requested features and prepared an exciting new update. Plus, a brand-new trailer is coming your way very soon. Ready to dive into the details? 🚀

[b]🌟 What’s New?[/b]
[list]
[*] A Brand-New Map: We listened to your feedback and completely redesigned the map! It’s now more colorful, more fun, and packed with details waiting to be explored.
[*] Flea Market: We’ve added Flea Markets to two locations on the map. Here, you can find random products at prices well below the market value and purchase them by placing bids.
[*] New Employee: Stacker: You can now hire a Stacker!
[*] They help unload products from your vehicle.
[*] They stock shelves with items from boxes and dispose of empty boxes.
[*] Lightens your workload and keeps your storage area organized!
[*] Advanced Settings Menu: New graphical settings like texture quality and additional performance options have been added, allowing you to optimize the game for your system.
[*] Localization and Minor Fixes: We’ve improved localization and resolved minor bugs to enhance your experience.
[/list]

[b]🚀 What’s Coming Next?[/b]
In addition to this big update, we’d like to give you a sneak peek at some upcoming features:

[list]
[*] Drone Deliveries: City deliveries won’t rely solely on your courier anymore. With the Drone feature, you’ll be able to handle high-volume sales later in the game without worrying about delays.
[*] Remote Warehouse Management: Managing your warehouse is about to get easier! You’ll be able to purchase a tablet from the Equipment section to remotely manage your inventory and track stock.
[*] GPS for Easier Deliveries: From the Equipment section, you’ll also be able to buy a GPS device to easily see which box belongs to which NPC during city deliveries.
[*] Product Repair System: Repair broken products and return them to your sales inventory.
[*] Seasonal and Holiday Products: Celebrate special occasions like New Year, Halloween, and Valentine’s Day with exclusive seasonal products to spice up your sales.
[/list]

And much more!

Every piece of feedback from you is incredibly valuable to us. With your support, we’ll continue to make Top Sellers even better. Wishing you all happy gaming! 🎮

Warm regards,
The Top Sellers Team
